p: The guest in room 8006 checked in a day or two ago, but I don't remember exactly which day it was. They came around one or two in the morning. At that time, I was on night shift alone and saw that person wearing a strange outfit, wearing a hat, sunglasses, and a black mask, dragging a large black box. It left a deep impression on me. Because it was a reservation call from someone who claimed to be our Miss Yan Jing, and everything was normal at the time, I didn't ask much. I thought the Miss was dating someone and didn't want to be recognized.
Shang Jian's belongings: There is an old photo in the wallet, showing a couple and a pair of underage children. The boy looks like a young Shang Jian.
Shang Jian's stuff: There is a high-end small microphone for mobile karaoke in the pocket.
